step.action: Inspect the current food permit and daily 🍷 Food_Service_Checklist.
step.ifThen: IF either required document is missing, THEN do not open and tell the Food Lead.

step.action: Confirm that you have no vomiting, diarrhea, jaundice, fever with sore throat, or infected hand wound.
step.ifThen: IF you have any listed symptom, THEN do not handle food and tell the Food Lead.

step.action: Secure your hair with one restraint from 🍷 Hair_Restraints.
Wash your hands at 📦 Handwashing_Station.
Put on one clean apron from 🍷 Disposable_Aprons.
Spray 🍷 Cheese_Work_Surface with 🍷 Multisurface_Cleaner.
Wipe the work surface with 🍷 Disposable_Towels until no visible soil remains.
Dampen a new disposable towel with potable water from 🍳 Drinking_Water_Dispensers.
Wipe every cleaned part of the work surface with the damp towel.
Put the used towels in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Spray the work surface with 🍷 Food_Surface_Sanitizer until it is visibly wet.
Leave the work surface visibly wet for 60 seconds.
Allow the work surface to air dry.
Measure 🍷 Cheese_of_the_Day with 🍷 Food_Probe_Thermometer.
step.ifThen: IF the cheese is above 41°F, THEN keep it out of service and tell the Food Lead.

step.action: Spray the thermometer probe with 🍷 Multisurface_Cleaner.
Wipe the probe with 🍷 Disposable_Towels until no cheese remains.
Dampen a new disposable towel with potable water from 🍳 Drinking_Water_Dispensers.
Wipe every cleaned part of the probe with the damp towel.
Put the used towels in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Spray the probe with 🍷 Food_Surface_Sanitizer until it is visibly wet.
Leave the probe visibly wet for 60 seconds.
Allow the probe to air dry.
Write the cheese name from 🍷 Pairing_List on 🍷 Cheese_Name_Board.
Put sealed ice bags from 🍷 Ice_Storage in 🍷 Cheese_Serving_Trays.
Place 🍷 Tray_Grids_and_Mats above the ice.
Complete the opening entries on 🍷 Food_Service_Checklist.
Wash your hands again at 📦 Handwashing_Station.
Put on one clean pair from 🍷 Disposable_Food_Gloves.

passWhen.criterion: The required permit and daily checklist are present.
The worker is healthy, hair is restrained, hands are washed, and apron and gloves are clean.
The work surface is sanitized and air-dry.
The cheese is at or below 41°F.
The thermometer probe is clean, sanitized, and air-dry.
The cheese name is displayed and the trays, ice, grids, and mats are ready.

reasoning.entry: Gloves are put on after cleaning and equipment setup so the worker does not contaminate them before touching ready-to-eat food.
The sanitizer label requires visible soil removal, washing, and a potable-water rinse before the 60-second food-contact sanitizing step.
